definitions.explanation: The holiday celebrated on December 25th, widely observed in Japan as a secular celebration.

examples.japanese: クリスマスは{家族|かぞく}と{過|す}ごす{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to spend Christmas with my family.

examples.japanese: クリスマスプレゼントに{何|なに}が{欲|ほ}しい？
examples.english: What do you want for a Christmas present?

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では、クリスマスイブに{恋人|こいびと}と{過|す}ごすカップルが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In Japan, many couples spend Christmas Eve with their significant others.
examples.notes: Cultural note about Japanese Christmas customs

notes:
CULTURAL NOTES: In Japan, Christmas is celebrated more as a secular, commercial holiday than a religious one. Christmas Eve is considered a romantic occasion for couples. Eating fried chicken (especially KFC) and Christmas cake on Christmas are popular traditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・クリスマスツリー (Christmas tree)
・クリスマスプレゼント (Christmas present)
・クリスマスケーキ (Christmas cake)
・クリスマスイブ (Christmas Eve)
・クリスマスソング (Christmas song)
・メリークリスマス (Merry Christmas)
